displayIdentity.body: Seven weeks are counted from the beginning of harvest; a freewill gift reflects blessing, and household, servants, Levite, foreigner, orphan, and widow rejoice together while slavery is remembered.
displayIdentity.title: Weeks begins with the sickle and widens into shared joy
